content: In the R. Anjām Ibn Turka says Sufism is a mode of wisdom formulated in terms of Muḥammad's Sunna and the prescriptions of his revelation, and mainstream philosophy is a complementary science formulated in terms of inductive proofs and rational demonstrations; each has its place among the permitted sciences and required practices. Melvin-Koushki concludes that both are inferior to lettrism yet remain necessary and noble disciplines in their own right.
